## Type of change

<!-- Check all that apply. The PR title must follow Conventional Commits (e.g. `feat(frontend): ...`). -->

- [ ] `feat` — new feature
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `refactor` — code change that neither fixes a bug nor adds a feature
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `chore` — tooling, build, dependencies
- [ ] `test` — adding or fixing tests
- [ ] **Breaking change** — would require users to change their setup

## How was this tested?

<!-- Describe the steps you took to verify your change. -->

- [ ] `pnpm build` passes
- [ ] `pnpm lint` passes
- [ ] Manually verified the affected feature

## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) with a scope (`feat(frontend):`, `fix(backend):`, …)
- [ ] I read the [Contributing guide](../blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] My code follows the project architecture (Clean Architecture backend, Feature-Sliced Design frontend)
- [ ] I updated documentation where relevant
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or `.env` values are committed
